_comment: marble_bars: Map 2's start/finish gate, the marble answer to Map 1's hell-rock rock_bars -- 12.85 m wide (local X across the lane), 8.5 m tall, 0.5 m deep (local Z along the lane), origin at the base centre, y=0 the ground. IT SPANS THE WALKWAY WALL TO LIP (Ryan, 2026-09-23: "the gate doesnt block anyone from going past it to the portal"): on rock_bars' inherited 10.6 m centred on the lane at r 52.0 the collider reached r 46.7007..57.3005 against a walkway of r 46.7..59.55, leaving 2.2495 m of open floor outboard that a body walked round, so the width is now WALL_R 59.55 less LIP_R 46.7 and the scene stands the centre at r 53.125. The extra 2.25 m went into the FLANKING ASHLAR FIELD and nowhere else -- the mouth, the jambs on mb.PILASTER_W, the twelve bars and their 0.342 pitch are untouched, and the topology is untouched with them: 1384 tris before the widening and 1384 after. An IRON PORTCULLIS IN A MARBLE FRAME, built out of the rotunda's own architecture: a socle to 0.85 at the full depth, a ledge where the screen sets back 0.12 (the rotunda's pilasters stand mb.PILASTER_PROUD 0.45 off a 3 m wall; a 0.5 m gate affords 0.12, the one number this model interprets), fluted pilaster jambs on mb.PILASTER_W 1.0 with marble returns, a 6.0 x 6.2 m mouth under a SEMICIRCULAR head of radius 3.0 in mb.HEAD_SEG 6 segments crowning at 7.20, and a cornice 7.70 .. 8.50 in marble_wall_build._cornice's own order -- soffit shade, front in three band, top in three shade. In the mouth hang 12 vertical bars of the cell bars' own iron, 0.13 m square (2 * mb.BAR_HW), at a 0.342 m pitch, with 3 horizontal cross-bars at 2.0 / 3.0 / 4.0: no gap anywhere is wider than 0.342, under rock_bars' guaranteed 0.38. ONE CLOSED CONTIGUOUS MESH: the bars' feet are cut out of the sill and the cross-bars' ends out of the jamb reveals, marble_wall_build._sill style, and every bar's head is cut out of the head soffit on the soffit's OWN polyline, so stone and iron share those edges and the arch closes on the iron with no lens of daylight. mb.audit: components 1, boundary 0, doubled 0, over 0, degenerate 0, duplicate positions 0; Euler 590 - 2076 + 1384 = -102, genus 52, which is exactly the 13 x 4 openings the grid makes and not one more. SEVEN TEXTURED MATERIALS, one tiling sheet per material class on lib/texel.py, replacing marble's packed 256 px atlas and its per-face random windows -- which left this gate a flat cold wash beside the coursed ashlar of the wall it stands in. marble, marble2, shade and plinth are the rotunda's own stone at its own density, mb.WALL_MPT (0.046019 m a texel) on a sheet mb.WALL_H (261) texels tall = 12 courses of 1.0 m and 65 across = 2.991 m of 1.50 m blocks, half-bonded. The gate is a flat slab and not a ring, so they project "box" -- world x/y/z by the face normal's largest axis, in the gate's OWN frame, which is the frame its joints must line up with -- and the courses are therefore level lines right across the screen and on through the jamb reveals: phase V0 puts a joint exactly on the SILL (1.0) and the socle's own phase puts its single joint on the LEDGE (0.85), so the socle is one course of stone, and the gate's z 0 is the walkway deck 24 courses over the rotunda's FLOOR_Z, so those lines are the wall's own course lines. band (the cornice fillets) and column (the fluting) are fitted to their faces as the rotunda fits them. iron is the cell bars' near-black #181a1f with its lit rim #686e7a on the PORTCULLIS' OWN MODULE, 0.4715 m (the uprights' centre pitch) across 58 texels = 0.00813 m a texel, so every upright's face lands on the same 16 texels of the sheet and wears the rim down its left arris while the cross-bars, which span the gaps, wear the base iron. One UV set, no skin, no animation. MarbleBarsCollision is one box over the gate's full width, height and depth (Ryan: "the collision for all the gates can just be a big rectangle"), shipped as a `-boxcol` node; Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + BoxShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only the drawn mesh's seven and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn. max_tris 1600: the visual mesh is 1384 tris, of which the iron is 844 (the 12 uprights are split at every cross-bar edge so the cross-bars' ends can close their side faces) and the mouth's cut sill, reveals and soffit 262. tests/test_marble_gate.gd is the proof in the scene: a 0.4 x 1.8 m capsule driven at the gate at 11 m/s from radial offsets spanning the whole walkway, a sweep of the collider for any opening wider than 0.38 m, and the top against a 7 m/s jump (1.11 m over the deck at gravity 22).
